title: Austin Housing Fund Boosts Holly Repairs
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved an additional $1.5 million in funding for the Holly Good Neighbor Program.
*   Allocated nearly $12 million in total for housing initiatives through September 2010.
*   Authorized contracts to immediately begin substantial home repairs and rehabilitation work in the Holly Neighborhood.
